_notice: Independent blind set v6 for HerBiz retrieval, written by a fresh agent from general knowledge + article title list only; not tax-reviewed; not legal advice.

questions.text: hi, i run a home bakery in sharjah (cakes, brownies, eid boxes). last 12 months my sales came to around 4,10,000 dirhams i think, mostly from instagram orders. do i HAVE to register for vat now or is it optional? and does it count from when i started or just last year??
questions.source_rationale: Mandatory registration rests on the Decree-Law article and the Executive Regulation detail; the threshold calculation article and FTA registration page help explain the 12-month look-back and AED 375,000 figure.

questions.text: My candle business is small, sales maybe AED 120k a year but I spend a lot on wax, jars, packaging (around 200k incl. the new equipment). Someone told me I can register voluntarily and claim back the vat I pay on supplies. Is that true, what's the minimum I need?
questions.source_rationale: Voluntary registration on the basis of supplies or expenses is set by DL8 Article 17 and ER Article 8; the FTA page gives the AED 187,500 figure and input recovery explains the benefit.

questions.text: I live in Muscat but sell handmade abayas to ladies in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, ship from Oman, no shop or license in UAE. sales to UAE are small like 50-60k AED. do i still need a UAE vat number or am i under the limit?
questions.source_rationale: Registration of a person with no place of residence in the UAE is governed by DL8 Article 18; the general mandatory registration rules and place of establishment give context.

questions.text: FTA sent me a msg saying I need to register for corporate tax by end of the month. My freelance permit income is around 90k a year. Is there a fine if I miss it and do I pay 9% on everything??
questions.source_rationale: Corporate tax registration, deadlines and the 9% rate fall under the UAE Corporate Tax law, not the VAT Decree-Law or its Executive Regulation.

questions.text: all my sales are exports - i make spice blends and ship 100% to customers in the UK and Canada. turnover went above 400k aed this year. can i ask FTA to not register me since everything I sell is zero rated anyway?
questions.source_rationale: The exception from registration for persons making only zero-rated supplies is in DL8 Article 15 and ER Article 16; export zero-rating supports why the supplies are zero-rated.

questions.text: Closing my home catering business next month bc I'm moving back to India. I'm vat registered since 2023. what do i need to do to cancel the TRN and how long do i have? also do i still need to pay vat on the leftover stock/equipment??
questions.source_rationale: Deregistration cases and the regulation's procedure answer the main question; the application article and liabilities due before deregistration cover timing and remaining obligations.

questions.text: me and my husband each have a separate home business license, mine is for makeup services and his is for photography, we do a lot of weddings together. each of us earns around AED 250,000. if we keep them separate we're both under the vat limit right? or will fta add us together
questions.source_rationale: The Executive Regulation article on aggregation of related parties addresses splitting a business to stay under the threshold; the related-parties definition and mandatory registration add context.

questions.text: just got my TRN yay. what exactly do i have to put on my invoices now? i used to just send a whatsapp screenshot with the price lol. do i need arabic, the word tax invoice, my trn, customer trn??
questions.source_rationale: Conditions for issuing tax invoices are in DL8 Article 65 and the detailed contents in ER Article 59; stating the TRN and the invoice issue date are supporting.

questions.text: A corporate client returned 30 of the 100 gift hampers (AED 15,750 incl vat) because of a delivery mistake and I refunded them. I already put the full amount in my last vat return. How do I fix that, do I issue some kind of credit note?
questions.source_rationale: Adjusting output tax through a tax credit note is governed by DL8 Article 63 and ER Article 60; the output tax adjustment instances and mechanism articles support the answer.

questions.text: an event company owes me 22k for decor I did 8 months ago, they stopped answering. I already paid the vat on that invoice to FTA :( can i get that vat back if they never pay?
questions.source_rationale: Bad debt relief conditions sit in DL8 Article 64; the general output tax adjustment articles provide the mechanism.

questions.topic: bundled hamper with class (single vs multiple supply)
questions.text: I sell a 'Ramadan box' for AED 399 – it has dates and chocolates, a printed recipe book, AND a voucher for a 2 hr online baking class with me. Do I charge 5% on the whole box or do the parts get treated differently? some of my customers are in KSA too
questions.source_rationale: Ambiguous: the facts could be a single composite supply or multiple supplies with apportioned consideration (DL8 8, ER 4, ER 46, ER 26), and the KSA customers and online class also raise place-of-supply questions for services.

questions.text: I'm a freelance graphic designer in Ajman, VAT registered. Most of my clients are startups in London and Berlin, they pay me in GBP/EUR and have no office in UAE. do I charge them 5% or 0%? what proof do i need to keep
questions.source_rationale: Zero-rating of exported services relies on DL8 Article 45 and the conditions in ER Article 31; place of supply of services and invoice currency rules support the answer.

questions.text: how much does the DED home business licence cost in dubai now? and can I run a food business from my villa kitchen or do I need municipality approval first
questions.source_rationale: Trade licence fees and municipality food-safety approval are licensing matters, not UAE VAT law.

questions.text: my price list on insta says 'Lash extensions – 250 aed'. now that im registered, is the 250 supposed to include vat or can i add 5% on top at the till? customers are getting confused
questions.source_rationale: Tax-inclusive pricing for displayed prices is in DL8 Article 38; ER Article 27 on price excluding tax adds the exceptions.

questions.text: When is my first VAT return due? registered 1 March 2026. is it every 3 months or monthly, and how many days after the quarter do I have to file AND pay? scared of missing it
questions.source_rationale: Tax period duration, return submission and the regulation's 28-day filing and payment rule answer the question; length of tax period and settlement of tax support.

questions.text: how long do I need to keep all my receipts and invoices? i have a shoebox full of paper bills from 2021 lol. can i just scan them and throw the paper away
questions.source_rationale: Record-keeping obligations and retention period are in DL8 Article 78 and ER Article 71; ER Article 72 on records of supplies made is supporting.

questions.text: can i claim the vat on: (1) a new iPhone i use for the business insta, (2) client lunches at cafes, (3) petrol for my car that I use for deliveries + school run?? accountant cousin says some of these are blocked
questions.source_rationale: General input tax recovery (DL8 54) and the blocked categories such as entertainment and private-use motor vehicles (ER 53) are essential; apportionment helps for mixed-use items.

questions.text: Bought a big commercial oven & mixer for AED 31,500 (incl. 1,500 VAT) in Jan, but only got registered in May. Can I still claim that 1.5k back in my first return or is it lost?
questions.source_rationale: Input tax paid before registration is governed by DL8 Article 56; the recovery timing and recoverable input tax articles support.

questions.text: My sister runs the same cookie brand in Riyadh. ZATCA is asking her for e-invoicing phase 2 integration. what's the 15% vat threshold there and does she need a QR code on invoices?
questions.source_rationale: Saudi Arabian VAT and ZATCA e-invoicing are outside the UAE VAT Decree-Law and its Executive Regulation.

questions.text: I give free cupcake boxes to influencers for reviews, roughly 40 boxes a month worth 120 AED each. Do i have to pay vat on stuff i give away for free? I've already claimed the vat on the ingredients
questions.source_rationale: Gifts where input tax was recovered fall under deemed supply (DL8 11) and its exceptions such as the low-value business gift limits (ER 5); DL8 12 and the value of deemed supply support.

questions.text: thinking of selling gift cards for my nail studio - AED 200, 500, 1000. when do i charge vat, when someone buys the card or when the friend comes in and uses it? what if they never use it
questions.source_rationale: Value of supply of vouchers is in DL8 Article 40 and the regulation's discounts, subsidies and vouchers article; date of supply in special cases supports timing.

questions.text: Besides my small tailoring biz (vat registered) I rent out a 1BR apartment in JVC to a family for 65k/yr. Do I have to charge them vat on the rent too? and can i claim vat on the maintenance for that flat?
questions.source_rationale: Exemption of residential leasing rests on DL8 Article 46 and ER Article 43; input tax relating to exempt supplies and apportionment cover the maintenance question.

questions.topic: online course sales: electronic services vs export
questions.text: I sell pre-recorded crochet courses on my own website, AED 149 each. buyers are all over – UAE, India, US, a few in Bahrain. it's automatic download, I never meet them. Which ones do I charge vat to?? do I need to check where each buyer lives
questions.source_rationale: Ambiguous: automated courses could be treated as electronic services with special place-of-supply rules (DL8 31, ER 23) or as ordinary services exported to non-residents eligible for zero rating (DL8 45, ER 31); the facts do not settle which route applies.

questions.text: bank keeps rejecting my business account application because my home licence is 'high risk' and they want 50k minimum balance. which UAE bank is easiest for a small home business, any with zero balance?
questions.source_rationale: Choosing a bank and meeting account minimums is a banking question, not a UAE VAT law question.
